integrity: The formula and stability factorization have an analytical proof; checker.py verifies bivariate algebraic identities exactly and performs finite zero-sum and quadrature consistency tests. No independent external audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Sharp lower real two-tone Fourier fourth-moment bounds only for positive distinct integer frequencies with normalized circle Haar measure; no sharp upper bounds, other exponents, extra tones or finite-order group aliasing claimed. title: A unique three-to-one resonance in sharp lower fourth moments of real two-tone Fourier spaces
